lines.text: It's a win-win for both of us.

data.define: Describes a deal that helps both sides.

example.text: It's a win-win for both of us.

misuse.text: Don't call a one-sided deal a 'win-win'.

publish.title: What does "win-win" mean?
publish.value: Win-win = Good for everyone. Example: "It's a win-win for both of us." (casual English).
